overview: Docket (1940-41) catalogs Japanese interference with American diplomatic, missionary, and business mail across Japan, China, Manchuria, and Indochina, culminating in October 1941's comprehensive foreign-mail censorship ordinance.

subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers for file 894.711, entries 65–87
subfiles.about: A four-page index summarizes and cross-references 1940–1941 records concerning Japanese censorship, detention, opening, and tampering with American mail.
subfiles.summary: Docket details 1940-41 Japanese mail interference incidents across Asia, bank and missionary correspondence tampering, and the October 1941 ordinance imposing comprehensive foreign-mail censorship.

interest: Shows Japan's 1940-41 escalation from scattered mail interference to comprehensive foreign-mail censorship across its empire.
